headline: Brazil Government to Send Selective Tax Provisional Measure to Congress
summary: Brazilian economic officials stated the government plans to send the Selective Tax provisional measure to Congress, targeting the start of collections in February following sector agreements.
why: Tax legislation and implementation timelines dictate fiscal revenue projections and regulatory compliance costs for affected industries.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Introduction of new tax legislation impacts corporate tax burdens and government revenue collection.
